head: WORKTREE
summary: Kafka KRaft and Schema Registry in compose, messaging-contracts module with 10 Avro schemas generated at build time, a git-tag-based BACKWARD check with named breaking-change fixtures, and a shared once-per-JVM Kafka+SR fixture proven by a round-trip IT. test-runner pass 319/319. Only minor gaps remain.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: infra/docker-compose.yml kafka (KRaft, apache/kafka:4.2.1) and schema-registry (cp 8.2.4) with healthchecks; versions recorded in ADR 0013 Infrastructure.
messaging-contracts/src/main/avro/*.avsc, namespace com.ledgerflow.messaging, avro-maven-plugin goal schema at generate-sources; AvroRoundTripIT uses the generated PaymentInitiated.

SchemaCompatibilityTest#everySchemaIsBackwardCompatibleWithTheLastRelease plus addingAFieldWithoutADefaultIsCaught, changingAFieldTypeIsCaught, removingAnEnumSymbolIsCaught; CI checkout uses fetch-depth: 0 for tags.

MessagingContainers static once-per-JVM fixture, exported as test-jar in parent dependencyManagement; AvroRoundTripIT#avroMessageRoundTripsThroughKafkaAndSchemaRegistry. spring-kafka and testcontainers-kafka are Boot-managed, as noted in ADR 0013.
README lists Kafka localhost:9092 and Schema Registry localhost:8085 and the new module; CI change is checkout depth only. Time budget not measured here.

findings.description: The release check iterates only over schema files present now. Deleting or renaming a released schema file, which breaks consumers, is not detected.
findings.suggestion: Also fail when a name parsed from the release tag is missing from the current set, or document that removal needs a major contract version.

findings.description: Brief asks for the Confluent repository scoped to its artifacts; Maven cannot do that, so it is global with snapshots disabled. Rationale is only in the review request, not in the POM.
findings.suggestion: Add a one-line POM comment stating that Maven cannot scope repositories per artifact.
